round1_dispositions.evidence: Consent prompt mid-call removed by D3; remaining call UI is existing.
Audio cannot precede consent: Connect records it (plan S3a). Precedence in S3b. Mockup contradiction is MB-5 N1.
Plan: alert names Flow only when the row is selectable.

new_findings.description: On mobile the daily cap surfaces as a failed turn; after repeated failures the call ends with the generic caption. The plan defines one caption line, not what happens to the call.
new_findings.suggested_fix: State in S3a that a cap error shows its message once and does not count toward ending the call, or that it ends with that message.
